acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: resuspended in 50 μL of 8 M Urea, reduced, alkylated, and digested with trypsin (Promega).

collision_energy.evidence: MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35 % collision energy in a data-dependent mode.

enrichment_method.evidence: cross-linked peptides were enriched by size exclusion chromatography using an ÄKTAmicro chromatography system (GE Healthcare) equipped with a SuperdexTM Peptide 3.2/30 column (column volume = 2.4 mL).

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35 % collision energy in a data-dependent mode.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: the fractions were analyzed by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) in technical duplicates.

labeling.evidence: inferred: The experiment was carried out in duplicates.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: LC-MS/MS analysis was performed on an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron, San Jose, CA).
